description: Known-answer vectors of the escaping of untrusted text in messages, read by the tests of audio_patch::safe_message and visual-cli's safe_message (Rust), and of oneLine (@poyetik/config). Each input and output is the concatenation of its pieces, each [text, times repeated].

vectors.name: plain
vectors.description: Plain text is unchanged, quotes and backslashes included.

vectors.name: unsafe
vectors.description: Every escaped range at both ends: C0, DEL and C1, the bidirectional formatting characters, the line and paragraph separators.

vectors.name: neighbors
vectors.description: The neighbors of every escaped range are kept, and so is other text.

vectors.name: past-the-limit
vectors.description: One character more: cut, and marked.

vectors.name: characters-not-units
vectors.description: The limit counts characters (code points), not UTF-16 units or bytes.

vectors.name: whole-escapes
vectors.description: An escape is never cut in the middle.

vectors.name: escape-across-the-limit
vectors.description: An escape that would cross the limit is dropped whole.
